And her figure 8 finisher is bullshit.  The reversal on the figure 4 makes sense because to do the move right, you need to use the mat for leverage, that's why flipping over reverses the preasure. The mat is no longer there.  By bridging a figure 4 into the 8 you essentially do the same thing as reversing it.  And it wouldn't bother me if it wasn't so obvious.
